messages:
alex: Staging shows a 5xx spike on /generate after the tokenizer tweak. Repro locally with small load. Need an expedited hotpatch to prod within the current change window.

deploy-bot: [DEPLOY QUEUED] hotfix/v1.2.3-hotfixb → prod (staging tests failed) - policy: expedite requires 2 approvals to skip canary or manual ramp. Use /deploy for commands.

megan: Are any paying customers impacted? severity?

alex: Two enterprise customers reported timeouts, confirmed timeout repro in staging. Root cause looks like a new kernel path in the tokenizer for long sequences.

sarah: Oncall here — I can give one expedited approval if we have a rollback plan and a clear ramp. Suggest rollback if error rate >2% or p95 >500ms in first 10m.

devmgr: I approve expedited deploy. Release note blurb: "tokenizer kernel fix to address 5xx on long contexts." Tagging @security for visibility; no KMS changes.

sam: Infra +1. Recommend manual ramping: 10% for 10m, then 50% for 5m, then full. If errors spike, cut traffic and rollback.

deploy-bot: approvals recorded: sarah, devmgr, sam. Policy 'expedite-minor' satisfied (3 approvals). Skipping automated full canary; executing manual ramp per request.

alex: Executing deploy now. Command run:
```
/deploy apply --manifest=hotfix/v1.2.3-hotfixb --target=prod --ramp=10%/10m,50%/5m --rollback-threshold="errors>2%/5m"
```

deploy-bot: [IN PROGRESS] Rolling out hotfix/v1.2.3-hotfixb to prod via manual ramp. Locking staging to prevent concurrent deploys. Change window: 15:00-16:00 UTC.

megan: Monitoring logs, traces, and SLOs. Will shout if anything odd.

deploy-bot: [SUCCESS] 10% step complete at 15:10 UTC. No anomalous increase in 5xx or latency in the first 10m. Proceeding to 50%.

oncall: 50% looks stable. p95 reduced to ~220ms, error rate 0.1%. No alerts.

deploy-bot: [SUCCESS] Hotfix/v1.2.3-hotfixb fully promoted to prod at 15:27 UTC. Release notes updated: https://internal/release/1.2.3-hotfixb.

alex: Thanks team — keeping staging locked for +30m post-deploy for additional smoke. Will file a short postmortem in eng-releases if any regression appears. :tada:
